title: Flight prices in: YYZ routing wins at $407 CAD total
headline: Toronto airports beat Buffalo: $407 in flights
detail: Google Flights (taxes+fees included for 1 adult, per its results page). Outbound Oct 10: YYZ->LGA Air Canada nonstop CA$257 (9:00pm-10:36pm, 1 free carry-on) beats YTZ->EWR Porter CA$279 (via Ottawa, carry-on extra) and BUF->EWR Frontier CA$298 (via Atlanta, 7h44m, carry-on extra). Return Oct 18: BOS->YYZ Air Canada nonstop CA$150 (6:00am-7:56am, carry-on extra) beats BOS->BUF JetBlue CA$262 (carry-on free). Buffalo routing = CA$560 flights + gas/parking/tolls (~$175-225 est) vs YYZ routing CA$407 total, no drive cost.
